    {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}
  ],

    {"name": "job", "params": [["state", "St"], ["msg", "Msg"], ["k", "Small"]],
     "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None}
  ],

  "entries": ["job"],
  "machine": {
    "states": STATES, "initial": "S0",
    "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
    "transitions": [
      {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "a", "cost": 2, "when": None},
      {"from": "S0", "to": "S2", "command": "b", "cost": 2, "when": None},
      {"from": "S0", "to": "S3", "command": "z", "cost": 4, "when": None},

      {"from": "S2", "to": "S3", "command": "d", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "S3", "to": "S1", "command": "e", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "S0", "to": "S4", "command": "h", "cost": 2, "when": None},
      {"from": "S2", "to": "S4", "command": "g", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "A", "to": "B", "command": "bb", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "A", "to": "C", "command": "aa", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "B", "to": "D", "command": "zz", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "C", "to": "D", "command": "yy", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "S1", "to": "S4", "command": "k", "cost": 5,
       "when": ["eq", ["var", "k"], ["const", "Small", 7]]},
      {"from": "S4", "to": "S4", "command": "loop", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "Z", "to": "S0", "command": "back", "cost": 1, "when": None}
    ]
  },
  "runs": []
}

    ("S3", "abc", 0),        # S0->S1->S3 cost 3 (not direct z cost 4)
    ("S4", "x", 0),          # direct h cost 2
    ("D", "q", 0),           # lex tie: A->C->D = aa,yy
    ("S1", "m", 0),          # S0->S1 (a, 2) vs S0->S3->S1 (z?4+c?1+... ) -> a
    ("Z", "nope", 0),        # unreachable from S0
    ("S4", "g", 7),          # with k=7 the k transition exists but cost 5+2 > 2
    ("S2", "b", 0),
]
for state, msg, k in cases:
    chars = []
    payload = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(msg.ljust(8, '\x00')[:8]):
        payload.append(("x%d" % (4 + i), enc(ord(ch), 1)))
    runs.append({"entry": "job", "ktest": ktest(
        [("x0", enc(STATES.index(state), 4)), ("x1", enc(0, 1))] + payload +
        [("x12", enc(1, 1))])})
# slots: state enum x0 (4), msg string buffer x1, chars x2..x9, k x10, r x11
runs = []
for state, msg, k in cases:
